t: You're thinking about the Harley Manuscripts, one of the main closed collections of the British Library, which was formerly part of the British Museum's library. It was founded by Robert Harley, first Earl of Oxford, who served as Lord High Treasurer to Queen Anne from 1711 to 1714 and is sometimes called a prime minister. It then passed to his son Edward, the second Earl, a collector and patron of the arts. After Edward, it was owned by his wife Henrietta, the Countess of Oxford.
